Team handbook

Welcome to the team. This handbook explains how we work.

Vacation

Request vacation at least two weeks ahead. Your team lead approves it in the HR system.

Security

Passwords

Never share passwords. Store every password in the company password manager.

Laptops

Lock your laptop whenever you leave it. Report a lost laptop to the security team within one hour, even outside working
, even outside working hours, so they can wipe it remotely before anyone reads the data on it, and then file an
and then file an incident report that names the time, the place, and what was stored on the laptop.

Contacts

Ask questions in the help channel.
